label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Geo-targeting
body: Geo-targeting means showing your marketing messages to people based on their physical location, like a city or region.
caption:
This can be really useful for local businesses or if your service is only available in certain areas. For example, if you sell handmade crafts at local markets, you could share promotions only with people living nearby. It helps you focus your efforts where they'll make the most sense. Think about where your ideal customers are and tailor your approach. 🤔
